name: TDspDaisyVa
description: Virtual-analog synth voice built from DaisySP (Electrosmith, MIT): two band-limited (PolyBLEP) oscillators -> Moog ladder filter -> ADSR. AudioSynthDaisyVa wraps a voice as a mono int16 AudioStream node (idle-gated); DaisyVaSink is a MidiSink-driven, MPE-aware polyphonic pool with a small preset bank. NOT ElectroTechnique's GPL TSynth code.
